summary.text: Last named among the nine leaders of the Danaans whom Hector slew when Zeus vouchsafed him glory — distinct from `hipponous-trojan` son of Priam, Hipponous father of Capaneus, and Periboea's father Hipponous.

story.text: Hector, when Zeus vouchsafed him glory, smote Hipponous among the leaders of the Danaans — Asaeus first, and Autonous, and Opites and Dolops son of Clytius, and Opheltius, and Agelaus, and Aesymnus, and Orus, and Hipponous, staunch in fight — and thereafter fell upon the multitude.
